methodology: Independent visible stopwatch; exact build and fixture context. Cold clears actual client memory, warm FAST returns the same completed cached snapshot. Fixed parity compares matching stopped work against Node. LP residual tolerance is for containment only, never for dominance. Timed point values are not expected to be identical across stopping times.
